src/Model/Statement/Declaration/Column.p.role: Hold the resolved effective collation on the declared identity.

src/Rules/TableDefinition/TableDeclarati.role: Resolve effective table collation and retain the resolved field collation of a directly projected view column. The table declaration also records temporary provenance for resolved rename targets.

src/Statement/Table/Column/CollateAttrib.role: Associate the parsed COLLATE clause with the exact column specification.

src/Statement/Table/Column/OrdinaryColum.role: Supply the ordered checked attributes of each declared column.

src/Statement/Name/CollationName.php.role: Distinguish a named collation from DEFAULT.

src/Statement/Table/Option/CharsetOption.role: Distinguish the table charset option from column modifiers and unrelated clauses.

src/Statement/Table/Option/CollationOpti.role: Expose a named or unresolved table collation to the binding rule.

src/Statement/Name/CharsetName.php.role: Distinguish a named character set from DEFAULT without consulting the environment.

src/Lowering/TableDefinition/TableOption.role: Keep charset and collation table declarations distinct during parser lowering.

src/Rules/Query/Projection.php.role: Associate the projected field with the original identity and its declared type.

src/Model/Statement/Shape/Field.php.role: Expose the exact resolved source column behind a direct projection.

src/Model/Statement/Shape/OutputSlot.php.role: Retain direct heading facts at each ordered output position.

amendment: The analysis-only table declaration retains engine and prior key identity facts for the typed native index. Existing collation and namespace decisions keep their defined rules.
